statement.p: Design a rectangular milk carton box of width w, length l, and height h which holds 522 \text{ cm}^3 of milk. The sides of the box cost 2 \ \text{cents/cm}^2 and the top and bottom cost 3\ \text{cents/cm}^2. Find the dimensions of the box that minimize the total cost of materials used.

solution.p: The total cost of the four sides is (2hl+2wh)(2) cents. The cost of top and bottom is (2wl)(3) cents. Thus the total cost C (in cents) of the box is C = (2)(2)(h)(l+w) + (2)(3) wl. The volume in \text{cm}^3 is wlh = 522, so w,l,h are nonzero and we may divide and obtain l = \frac{522}{wh}. Plug this into the equation for C to obtain \begin{aligned} C \amp = (2)(2)h\left(\frac{522}{wh} + w\right) + (2)(3)(w)\frac{(522)}{wh}\\ \amp =\frac{(2)(2)(522)}{w} + (2)(2)hw + \frac{(2)(3)(522)}{h} \end{aligned} as a function of h and w. To minimize C, find the critical points of C by solving 0=C_h = (2)(2) w - \frac{(2)(3)(522)}{h^2} hence 2 wh^2 = (3)(522), and 0=C_w = \frac{(-2)(2)(522)}{w^2}+(2)(2)h so w^2h = 522. The quotient of these two results is \frac{2 wh^2}{w^2h} = \frac{(3)(522)}{522} so 2 h/w = 3 and h = \frac{3}{2} w .

Plug that into the equation w^2h = 522 to obtain 3 w^3 / 2 = 522 so w^3 = \frac{(2)(522)}{3}, h^3 = \left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^3 w^3 = \frac{(3^2)(522)}{2^2} and, l^3 = \frac{521}{w^3 h^3} = \frac{(2)(522)}{3} = w^3. Hence w = l = \left(\frac{(2)(522)}{3}\right)^{1/3}\approx {7.03385}, and h = \frac{3}{2} w \approx {10.5508}, centimeters.

Next we check that these dimensions minimize the cost C. At the critical point we find that C_{hh} = \frac{(6)(3)(522)}{h^3} = \frac{(6)(2^2)}{3} C_{ww} = \frac{(6)(2)(522)}{w^3} = (6)(3) C_{hw} = (2)(2)

D=C_{hh}C_{ww}-C^2_{hw} = (6^2)(2^2)-(2^2)(2^2) > 0. So, at the critical point, D > 0 and C_{hh} > 0 hence C has a local minimum. Since C has no other critical points, and C increases without bound as (w,h)\to (0,0) and as (w,h)\to(\infty,\infty), this local minimum must be a global minimum.
Therefore, the dimensions of the box that minimize the cost are w=l \approx {7.03385}\ cm and h \approx {10.5508}\ cm.
